# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 3 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 4 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 14 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 7 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 2 tokens; Size — 11 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--canvas, #f8f8f5);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #f8f8f5;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--canvas` | #f8f8f5 | App background behind every page. Warm off-white, never pure white. |
| `--surface` | #ffffff | Tables, forms, document previews and panels that sit on canvas. |
| `--surface-sunken` | #f1f2ee | Source-snippet wells, table header rows, read-only inputs. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #191d1b);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #191d1b;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #191d1b | Primary text and figures on canvas, surface and accent (16:1). |
| `--ink-muted` | #636963 | Secondary text, labels and helper copy on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (5.0:1 or better). |
| `--ink-subtle` | #777d78 | Brief's original secondary grey. 4:1 on canvas: placeholders and 24px+ text only, never body copy. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--accent-hover, #b6e84a);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #b6e84a;
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-accent` | #191d1b | Text and icons on accent fills (13.4:1). |
| `--accent-soft` | #eef9d2 | Selected table rows and the chosen lineup column background. |
| `--accent-ink` | #3f6212 | Text that must read as 'accent' on light grounds, e.g. 'Recommended' label (7:1 on surface). |

**Interaction states** (same roles, suffixed):

| token | light |
| --- | --- |
| `--accent-hover` | #b6e84a |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #e7e9e4);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone */
color: #e7e9e4;
```

### Tokens (14)

| token | light | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #e7e9e4 | Dividers and panel edges. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control. |
| `--line-control` | #858b85 | Borders of inputs, selects and checkboxes (3.5:1 on surface). |
| `--sidebar` | #171a19 | Sidebar and mobile top bar ground. |
| `--sidebar-raised` | #232826 | Hovered and active nav rows inside the sidebar. |
| `--sidebar-ink` | #e9ece6 | Nav labels and headings on sidebar (14.7:1). |
| `--sidebar-muted` | #8e958f | Nav section labels and counts on sidebar (5.7:1). |
| `--accent` | #c7f464 | Lime. Primary action fill, active-nav marker, recommended rule. A FILL, never text on light grounds (1.2:1). |
| `--success` | #276b43 | Confirmed-by-team, Approved, Paid. Text and icons on surface and success-soft (5.6:1). |
| `--success-soft` | #e6f2ea | Ground of success chips and banners. |
| `--warning` | #8f5b00 | Uncertain fields, over-budget notes, quote nearing expiry. Text on warning-soft (5.1:1). |
| `--warning-soft` | #fbf0d9 | Ground of warning chips and banners. |
| `--danger` | #b42318 | Missing required fields, errors, destructive actions. Text on danger-soft (5.6:1). |
| `--danger-soft` | #fce9e7 | Ground of missing/error chips and banners. |
| `--focus` | #191d1b | 2px keyboard focus ring with a 2px canvas gap. Lime is too light to be a ring. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 600 24px/32px "Geist", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-page-title);
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page-title` | `.page-title`, `--text-page-title` | 24px / 32px | 600 | `sans` |  |
| `section-title` | `.section-title`, `--text-section-title` | 16px / 24px | 600 | `sans` |  |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `body-strong` | `.body-strong`, `--text-body-strong` | 14px / 20px | 500 | `sans` |  |
| `small` | `.small`, `--text-small` | 13px / 18px | 400 | `sans` |  |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 12px / 16px | 500 | `sans` |  |
| `figure` | `.figure`, `--text-figure` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `mono` |  |
| `figure-total` | `.figure-total`, `--text-figure-total` | 24px / 32px | 500 | `mono` |  |
| `step-number` | `.step-number`, `--text-step-number` | 12px / 16px | 500 | `mono` |  |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `"Geist", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `"Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SFMono-Regular", monospace` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (7)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Icon-to-label gap, chip padding. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Gap inside compact rows and button groups. |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Table cell padding, field label to input. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Panel padding on mobile, gap between fields. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Panel padding on desktop, gap between field groups. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Gap between page sections. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Page top padding on desktop. |

| --- | --- | --- |

```css
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer var(--shadow-doc), so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--shadow-doc` | 0 1px 2px rgba(25,29,27,0.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(25,29,27,0.06) | A4 document previews only: the one thing that sits 'on' the desk. |
| `--shadow-overlay` | 0 12px 32px rgba(25,29,27,0.16) | Menus, popovers, dialogs. |
